blocking_issues.location: pt-BR edition throughout, especially opening, evidence table, 'A arquitetura empresarial está passando de model-centric para context-centric', mindmap, continuous-evaluation and institutional-control sections
blocking_issues.issue: The PT-BR edition repeatedly exposes raw English/internal technical phrasing where natural Brazilian Portuguese is available: 'agentic', 'on-premise', 'baseline', 'gate', 'workflow(s)', 'model-centric', 'context-centric', 'assurance', 'spans de gestão', 'score', 'policy engines', 'harnesses', 'early adopters' and 'overhead'. The density is high enough that the edition reads as translated technical scaffolding rather than text originally edited in Brazilian Portuguese.
blocking_issues.required_fix: Perform a full PT-BR localization pass. Prefer natural Portuguese equivalents and explain genuinely necessary technical terms on first use. Preserve literal proper names such as CI-Work, CORPGEN, Enterprise Signals and TEVV-Athlon. Recheck every visual label and the pending PT-BR metadata for the same issue, without changing factual claims or the EN thesis.

required_fixes: Localize the complete PT-BR edition and PT-BR pending metadata, removing unnecessary raw-English editorial vocabulary while preserving technical meaning and semantic parity with EN.
Keep all currently verified quantitative claims, periods, caveats, maturity distinctions and falsifiers unchanged unless a factual revalidation independently requires a change.
Preserve the current visual evidence structure and values; only localize labels where needed.
evidence: OpenAI Enterprise Signals directly supports the provider-specific 64% Codex share and 8.3x versus 2.6x output-token intensity figures; the report correctly does not treat them as productivity estimates.
Microsoft Research CI-Work directly supports contextual-integrity violation rates of 15.8%-50.9%, leakage up to 26.7%, and the finding that model size/reasoning depth does not resolve the issue.
Nature Medicine (2026-09-15) directly supports 90.04% on-premise diagnostic accuracy, 83.8% on the second benchmark, and selective autonomy retaining 49.4% of cases at 98.9% accuracy.
The assessment meets the visual floor for format assessment: one table, one explicit chart and multiple structural visuals, with at least four useful visuals total.
limitations: OpenAI telemetry is provider-specific adoption evidence, not independent productivity evidence.
Clinical benchmark performance is not evidence of prospective clinical deployment at scale.
Enterprise benchmark results do not establish economy-wide labour or productivity effects.
notes: The technology signal itself is publishable in substance: it distinguishes deployment from scale, states constraints, includes contrary evidence and observable falsifiers, and does not rely on the internal technology ledger as public evidence. Rejection is publication-editorial, not a reversal of the substantive technology assessment.
